population_first_principles.finding: The 12 GiB byte gate does not establish Python execution time. The exact source still creates one Python list/object and one json.dumps call per token row; PATCH dominates 90.6% of the population.

blocking_findings.name: python_jsonl_population_not_execution_feasible
blocking_findings.finding: 474.72M per-token JSON objects plus zlib writes are not admitted by a capacity-only gate. Chunk-local .tolist avoids a full CPU tensor but still creates Python integers/lists for every code.

blocking_findings.name: preflight_helper_not_capability
blocking_findings.finding: SparseCaptureProducer can be constructed without a preflight receipt. M1552 pins M1434/M1174 bytes and describes reuse, but does not itself import/call build_runtime or enforce the 12/16 GiB gate before config/model/checkpoint/CUDA.

blocking_findings.name: original_validator_does_not_bind_canonical_coordinates_or_32_layer_inventory
blocking_findings.finding: After resealing, a spatial_x mutation to 999999999 is accepted. The validator also lacks exact M1458 input-shape/channel-axis/32-module inventory binding. Therefore synthetic format validation cannot authorize a real capture.

blocking_findings.name: monolithic_zlib_validation_memory
blocking_findings.finding: The producer writes one monolithic zlib stream and the validator read_bytes/decompresses the whole stream, so compressed-size admission does not bound validator RAM or wall time.

required_successor_design.PATCH: For the current deadline emit only streaming S1 histogram/debt; do not preserve 430.08M per-token groups. Defer S2 PATCH payload to paired-AEE integration.
required_successor_design.FC1_FC2: Keep the 44.64M TSBG population only with strict binary/RLE/chunked framing, not one JSON object per token.
required_successor_design.preflight: Produce and bind an estimate/time receipt before importing or calling config/model/checkpoint/CUDA code; make it a required capability for producer construction.
required_successor_design.validator: Hard-bind the exact 32-layer M1458 name/order/input-shape/output-shape/channel-axis inventory and recompute token coordinate bounds; validate incrementally by shard.
required_successor_design.weights: At integration time assert Linear weight=[out,in] and Conv2d weight=[out,in/groups,kH,kW] before beta extraction; diagnostic codebook remains non-authoritative.
